kinds.d: Device that sprays water over an area of lawn or bed.
Set of pipe, drippers and fittings that delivers water drop by drop to plants.
Porous hose that seeps water into the soil along its length.
Timer or controller that switches the water supply to a garden watering system.
Water-filled bag strapped round a tree trunk that releases water slowly into the root zone.
